sources.title: GitHub - lutzroeder/netron: Visualizer for neural network, deep ...
sources.snippet: Netron is a viewer for neural network, deep learning and machine learning models. Netron supports ONNX, TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch, torch.export, ExecuTorch, TorchScript, TensorFlow, Core ML, OpenVINO, Keras, Caffe, Darknet, Safetensors and NumPy. Netron has experimental support for MLIR, JAX, GGUF, RKNN, ncnn, MNN, PaddlePaddle and scikit-learn.

sources.title: A Neural Network Playground
sources.snippet: Blue shows a positive weight, which means the network is using that output of the neuron as given. An orange line shows that the network is assiging a negative weight. In the output layer, the dots are colored orange or blue depending on their original values. The background color shows what the network is predicting for a particular area.
